# SIML (IEC 61850-7-4:2007B6), profile default

coverage: 19 measured or mapped, 18 mapped, 1 excluded, 0 unmapped, 33 not measured

## Measurements

SIML.OpCntRs | operation-count | supervision.opcntrs
SIML.Pres | pressure | unit Pa | linesupervision.pres
SIML.Tmp | temperature | unit degC | linesupervision.tmp
SIML.Lev | level | unit m | siml.lev
SIML.H2O | moisture | unit % | siml.h2o
SIML.H2OPap | moisture | unit % | siml.h2opap
SIML.H2OAir | moisture | unit % | siml.h2oair
SIML.H2OTmp | temperature | unit degC | siml.h2otmp
SIML.H2ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.h2ppm
SIML.N2ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.n2ppm
SIML.COppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.coppm
SIML.CO2ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.co2ppm
SIML.CH4ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.ch4ppm
SIML.C2H2ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.c2h2ppm
SIML.C2H4ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.c2h4ppm
SIML.C2H6ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.c2h6ppm
SIML.O2ppm | concentration | unit ppm | siml.o2ppm
SIML.FltGas | volume | unit m³ | siml.fltgas
